reason: It's a brand new service and I haven't seen a single unboxing video or heard from a friend who used it. With my money I can't pay half up front to a name I don't know and wait three weeks hoping it shows up.
objection: What if the size or colour is wrong for my kids and I can't send it back? They only refund if it's damaged or not as ordered, and who decides that? I'd be stuck with it.
would_change_my_mind: Seeing real TikTok unboxings from Baghdad mums or a friend telling me her order came on time and matched the photo.
